# General Bikeshare Feed Specification

GBFS is an open data standard that makes it easier to discover and use shared mobility modes.

[Get Started](https://gbfs.org/get-started) [Documentation](https://gbfs.org/documentation)

# Why Use GBFS?

**The General Bikeshare Feed Specification (GBFS) enhances rider experience and boosts ridership by improving the discoverability and accessibility of shared mobility options.**

**Different stakeholders gain valuable benefits from adopting GBFS:**

### Operators

**Boost ridership and revenue** by enhancing the visibility and use of shared mobility options. **Increase your presence** in trip planners, win competitive tenders, and comply with local open data requirements by publishing your data through GBFS.

### Transportation Authorities

**Promote low-emission transport** and **maintain control** over mobility services by mandating that operators publish data in the GBFS format.

### Trip Planners

**Provide users with comprehensive travel options** in any city. Enable easy access to shared mobility modes by integrating GBFS into trip planning tools, making them fully discoverable.

[Get Started](https://gbfs.org/get-started) [Documentation](https://gbfs.org/documentation)

# What Does GBFS Do?

Free-floating systems

- **Vehicle Location** - Display the real-time location of available shared bikes, scooters, mopeds, or cars near users.
- **Vehicle Charge** - Show the current battery level of vehicles, helping users choose the best option.
- **Parking Bays** - Indicate designated parking areas where vehicles can be safely and properly returned.

[Get Started](https://gbfs.org/get-started) [Documentation](https://gbfs.org/documentation)

Dock-based Systems

- **Stations** - Display the locations of docking stations where users can find and return vehicles.
- **Availability** - Provide real-time updates on the availability of both vehicles and docking spaces.
- **Payment methods** - Show pricing information and available payment options within trip planning apps.

[Get Started](https://gbfs.org/get-started) [Documentation](https://gbfs.org/documentation)

# GBFS is straightforward to implement for both data providers and consumers. Using a simple JSON format, it supports seamless collaboration and interoperability across systems.
